{
  "dataset_name": "spambase",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "total_word_freq_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all word frequency features, capturing overall density of tracked vocabulary in the message.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 500.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_sum",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a single split point for overall vocabulary saturation, which often differs between solicited and unsolicited messages.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_3 + word_freq_4 + word_freq_5 + word_freq_6 + word_freq_7 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_12 + word_freq_13 + word_freq_14 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_16 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_21 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_27 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_30 + word_freq_31 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_33 + word_freq_34 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_36 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_38 + word_freq_39 + word_freq_40 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_42 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_freq_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of special character frequencies, indicating heavy punctuation/symbol use common in promotional content.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_sum",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree can split on overall symbolic noise level in a single threshold.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5"
    },
    {
      "name": "active_word_token_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of word_freq columns that are strictly positive, a proxy for vocabulary breadth.",
      "value_range": [0, 48],
      "feature_family": "indicator_count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Trees can split on how many distinct tracked tokens appear; high counts often co-occur with marketing emails.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(word_freq_0 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_1 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_2 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_3 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_4 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_5 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_6 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_7 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_8 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_9 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_10 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_11 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_12 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_13 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_14 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_15 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_16 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_17 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_18 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_19 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_20 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_21 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_22 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_23 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_24 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_25 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_26 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_27 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_28 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_29 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_30 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_31 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_32 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_33 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_34 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_35 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_36 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_37 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_38 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_39 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_40 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_41 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_42 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_43 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_44 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_45 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_46 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_47 > 0).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "max_word_freq",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Maximum frequency across all word features; highlights when any single token dominates the message.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_extremum",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Trees can detect over-concentration on a single keyword via one split.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(word_freq_0, word_freq_1), word_freq_2), word_freq_4), word_freq_5), word_freq_6), word_freq_11), word_freq_15), word_freq_17), word_freq_18), word_freq_19), word_freq_20), word_freq_22), word_freq_24), word_freq_25), word_freq_26), word_freq_27), word_freq_35), word_freq_36), word_freq_41), word_freq_43), word_freq_44), word_freq_45), word_freq_47)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_length_avg_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed average capital run length, compressing the extreme right tail.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "transform_log",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Stabilizes a highly skewed predictor so tree splits land in more informative regions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_average)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_length_total_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total number of capital letters across the message.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "transform_log",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compressed range improves split selection on heavy-tailed capital-letter totals.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_total)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_longest_to_avg_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the longest capital run to the average capital run, capturing burstiness of capitalization.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Distinguishes messages with one shouting block from uniformly capitalized text.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "capital_run_length_longest / (capital_run_length_average + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_capital_burst_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for unusually long capital letter runs (longest run > 50).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "threshold_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a clean binary cue for shouting-style content that trees can pick up immediately.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(capital_run_length_longest > 50, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_to_word_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of total special character frequency to total word frequency, capturing symbol-heavy phrasing.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree can split on relative symbolic density independent of message length.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5) / (word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_3 + word_freq_4 + word_freq_5 + word_freq_6 + word_freq_7 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_12 + word_freq_13 + word_freq_14 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_16 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_21 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_27 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_30 + word_freq_31 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_33 + word_freq_34 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_36 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_38 + word_freq_39 + word_freq_40 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_42 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47 + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dollar_and_exclaim_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of dollar-like and exclamation-like character frequencies (char_freq_4 * char_freq_5), capturing combined urgency-monetary cues.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 70.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_product",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree benefits from a precomputed multiplicative interaction between two strong symbolic indicators.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "char_freq_4 * char_freq_5"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_bucket_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of total capital letter count: 0 (<=20), 1 (<=100), 2 (<=500), 3 (>500).",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_bucket",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Precomputed bins give the tree a coarse but interpretable feature for capitalization intensity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(capital_run_length_total <= 20, 0, np.where(capital_run_length_total <= 100, 1, np.where(capital_run_length_total <= 500, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "promotional_language_intensity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment score combining heavy capitalization, high symbol density, and broad keyword usage into a single intensity proxy reflecting messages that read as promotional or unsolicited based on stylistic surface features.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bundles correlated stylistic cues into one feature so the tree can split on overall promotional tone with shallow depth.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_total) * 0.5 + (char_freq_4 + char_freq_5) * 2.0 + np.minimum(word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_26, 20.0) * 0.3"
    }
  ]
}
